name: popnow/popnow
description: PHP SDK for the PopNow AI video, image and music generation API: quote, create and poll tasks, upload files, manage assets and verify webhooks.

suggest.ext-curl: Preferred transport. Without it the client falls back to the https:// stream wrapper, which buffers upload bodies and does not honour http_proxy.
suggest.ext-bcmath: Used by Client::compareUsd() when present; an exact string comparison is used otherwise.

scripts.lint: find src tests examples scripts autoload.php -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
